wasde.description: World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE), one monthly report (or a range of reports) as USDA's long-format CSV: one row per report table, commodity, region, attribute and marketing year, with Value, Unit and ProjEstFlag (Proj. = projection, Est. = estimate, blank = history). January 2021 report on. The pack filters the rows by the spec's commodity, region, attribute, report_title, market_year and proj_est.

report.desc: report month YYYY-MM (2021-01 on), or "latest" (default: the newest report listed on USDA ESMIS whose CSV is posted)

start_report.desc: first report month YYYY-MM of a range (with end_report; one CSV per month, at most 72): for month-to-month revisions

end_report.desc: last report month YYYY-MM of a range (default: latest)

commodity.desc: Commodity as published, case-insensitive, one or a list: Corn, Wheat, "Oilseed, Soybean", "Meal, Soybean", "Oil, Soybean", Cotton, Rice, "Rice, milled", Sorghum, Barley, Oats, Sugar, Beef, Pork, Broiler, Turkey, Eggs, Milk, Coarse Grains ... (names differ by table)

region.desc: Region as published: United States, World, Foreign, a country (Brazil, China, European Union ...) or group (Major Exporters)

attribute.desc: Attribute as published: Ending Stocks, Production, Exports, Imports, Beginning Stocks, Feed and Residual, Avg. Farm Price, Area Planted, Yield per Harvested Acre, Domestic, Total ...

report_title.desc: ReportTitle (the report table), e.g. "U.S. Feed Grain and Corn Supply and Use", "World Corn Supply and Use"; the same item appears in several tables in different units

market_year.desc: MarketYear as published: 2026/27 for crops, 2026 for livestock (calendar year)

proj_est.desc: proj = projections (Proj.), est = estimates (Est.), none = rows with no flag (history and the reliability tables)

include_reliability.desc: true keeps the 'Reliability of ... Projections' tables (past forecast errors); default false drops them

farm_income.description: ERS Farm Income and Wealth Statistics, one release (default: the latest, scraped from the data-files page): U.S. and state farm income statement, cash receipts by commodity, government payments, production expenses, balance sheet (assets, debt, equity) and ratios, 1910 on (states 1949 on), current-year forecast. Nominal dollars ($1,000) with ChainType_GDP_Deflator; the pack streams the 111 MB CSV inside the release ZIP and keeps only the rows the spec asks for.

release.desc: "latest" (default) or a release date: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM (2014-08 on; releases are in February, late August/early September and late November/early December)

variable.desc: VariableDescriptionTotal as published, case-insensitive, one or a list: "Net farm income", "Net cash income", "Cash receipts value, all commodities , all" (sic), "Value of government payments, total", "Dec. 31 value of farm equity, all, excl. operator dwelling" ...

key.desc: artificialKey, one or a list: FIAUSNTFI--P (U.S. net farm income), FIAUSNTCI--P (U.S. net cash income); the 3rd-4th letters are the state

search.desc: case-insensitive text that VariableDescriptionTotal must contain (to discover variables: e.g. "government payments")

state.desc: US or a two-letter state code, one or a list (default: all)

farm_income_summary.description: The 'U.S. farm sector financial indicators' table of the latest release (one small .xlsx, billion dollars, last eight years with the forecast year marked F, e.g. 2026F, plus percent changes): cash income statement, farm income statement, balance sheet, debt by lender, debt-to-equity and debt-to-asset ratios. One row per line item with section and unit.

farm_income_archive.description: ERS archive of past forecasts and estimates (U.S. only): every release's value of net farm income (nfi), net cash income (nci) and cash receipts (cr_all) for each year, first 15 releases per year, February 1977 release on. For forecast accuracy and revision paths.

item.desc: nfi = net farm income, nci = net cash income, cr_all = cash receipts, all commodities (default: all three)

year.desc: one calendar year being forecast or estimated

baseline.description: USDA Agricultural Projections (the 10-year baseline of the Interagency Agricultural Projections Committee), one edition's ZIP: by default its machine-readable Projections<year>.csv (one row per commodity, attribute and year: supply and use, area, yield, prices for crops; production, use and prices for livestock and dairy), or one of its .xlsx tables (farm income, trade, macro assumptions ...).

edition.desc: "latest" (default: the most recent full release), "early" (the most recent early release, before the report), or the last projection year, e.g. 2035 or 2034 (projections to that year; full release)

member.desc: file in the ZIP, a glob (case-insensitive): default "Projections*.csv"; e.g. "*Farm receipts*" for Table 26 (farm income), "*Feed Grains*", "*Macroeoconomic*" (sic, as published)

header_row.desc: .xlsx member: 1-based row holding the column names (default: the first row with three or more filled cells)

commodity.desc: CSV member: commodity as published, case-insensitive, one or a list (Corn, Wheat, Soybeans, Upland Cotton, Beef, Pork, Broilers ...)

attribute.desc: CSV member: attribute as published (Ending stocks, Planted acres, Farm price ...)

year.desc: CSV member: year as published (2030/31 for marketing years, 2030 for calendar years), one or a list

wasde.name: WASDE monthly supply and use projections
wasde.description: World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates: U.S. and world supply, use, ending stocks, prices for grains, oilseeds, cotton, rice, sugar, livestock, poultry, dairy; monthly, 2021 on

farm_income.name: ERS farm income and wealth statistics (U.S. and states)
farm_income.description: net farm income, net cash farm income, cash receipts by commodity, government payments, expenses, farm assets, debt, equity; annual 1910 on with the current-year forecast

farm_income_summary.name: U.S. farm sector financial indicators (latest forecast table)
farm_income_summary.description: one-page summary of the latest farm income forecast in billion dollars, with the forecast year marked F

farm_income_archive.name: Archive of past farm income forecasts
farm_income_archive.description: net farm income, net cash income and cash receipts as forecast and estimated in each release since 1977: forecast accuracy, revisions

baseline.name: USDA Agricultural Projections (10-year baseline)
baseline.description: long-term projections of U.S. crop and livestock supply, use, prices, farm income and trade, ten years ahead, under current law
